name: Optimisarr (dev)
description: Optimisarr (dev) - DEV/pre-release build of the gnolnos fork (ghcr.io/gnolnos/optimisarr:dev). FFmpeg media optimiser: verify, re-encode (CPU, Intel QSV/VA-API, NVIDIA NVENC, AMD AMF) and rollback-safe media replacement in Plex/Jellyfin/Emby, with remote Windows/macOS/Linux sidecar workers. This dev image tracks the fork's dev branch and may include features not yet in the stable release (e.g. signed A/B streaming and live job detail) - test on a copy of a library before enabling automatic replacement, not on production media. Store root '/data' must be one mount shared by media, work and quarantine so replacements use atomic moves.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent app state: SQLite database + config. Keep separate from a stable Optimisarr install so the two never share state.

paths.name: Storage root
paths.description: One read-write root for media, temporary output and quarantine. Keeping them under one container mapping preserves atomic moves.

variables.name: Work directory
variables.description: Temporary transcode output inside the storage root.

variables.name: Quarantine directory
variables.description: Rollback originals inside the storage root.

variables.name: Remote workers
variables.description: Remote sidecar workers are available by default. Set false to disable the worker service.

variables.name: Admin Token
variables.description: Optional. When set, the admin API and UI require this bearer token. Leave blank to rely on VPN/reverse-proxy.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid 'nobody' is 99).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid 'users' is 100).

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permissions mask for files Optimisarr creates.
